detached_structure.evidence: A small gray-roofed structure sits just northeast of the main house, near the deck or patio area, and may be a small outbuilding or a house extension.

signals.notes: Heavily wooded lot with a gray-shingled house in a clearing; dense canopy hides much of the yard. The dark round object at the right and the gray-roofed building at lower right are outside the outline and belong to neighbors.
